title: What can I build in a two-week jam?
subtitle: One question: what is this game, and what has to go for it to ship in two weeks?

data.question: What is this game, and what has to go for it to ship in two weeks?
howto: Work in ink, in the colours on this page.
When the time is up, stop mid-sentence.
Photograph every page and send them back.

pages.title: The game on one page
pages.prompt: A word or two in every box before you make any of them good. An empty box is an answer too.

pages.title: What the player keeps doing
pages.prompt: Draw the loop as it is in your head today. Circle any step that needs a whole sentence to explain.

pages.title: What ships, what waits, what goes
pages.prompt: Every feature goes in one pile. A feature you can't place is a question, not a must-have.

data.source: the features on your one-pager, W1-P2

pages.title: The jam ended and it didn't ship
pages.prompt: It is the last hour of the jam and the build won't run. Write down what happened.
